crazing.cause: Thermal stress from rapid, uneven cooling during casting

actions.Low: Log the part and watch the cooling spray nozzles
actions.Medium: Hold the part; inspect cooling spray nozzles before next batch
actions.High: Quarantine the coil and inspect the cooling spray nozzles now

inclusion.cause: Non-metallic slag or refractory particles trapped in the steel

actions.Low: Log the part; check tundish slag flux coverage at next stop
actions.Medium: Flag the slab batch and check tundish slag flux coverage
actions.High: Quarantine the slab batch and check tundish slag flux coverage now

patches.cause: Uneven pickling acid residue or rolling emulsion stain on the strip

actions.Low: Log the part; check pickling rinse sprays at next stop
actions.Medium: Clean the strip surface and check the pickling rinse sprays
actions.High: Hold the strip and check the pickling tank and rinse sprays now

pitted_surface.cause: Work-roll spalling or hard oxide particles pressed into the surface

actions.Low: Log the part and inspect the work rolls at the next stop
actions.Medium: Inspect the work rolls for pitting before the next batch
actions.High: Quarantine the part and inspect the work rolls for pitting now

rolled-in_scale.cause: Incomplete high-pressure descaling before hot rolling

actions.Low: Log the part; check descaler nozzle pressure at next stop
actions.Medium: Check the descaler nozzle pressure and flag the sheet
actions.High: Quarantine the sheet and increase the descaler nozzle pressure now

scratches.cause: Mechanical friction from misaligned guide rails or roller burrs

actions.Low: Log the part; check conveyor guide rails at next stop
actions.Medium: Inspect the guide rails and rollers for burrs before the next batch
actions.High: Quarantine the part, align guide rails and deburr contact rollers now
